_meta.requirement: Add injury/depth ablations, not fixed penalties: compare identical models with and without verified availability features on chronological holdouts.
_meta.why: no verified availability feed covers the backtest window. The official injury report is a snapshot with no archive, 254-352 rows of text with 6 designated game statuses, and no inactive list or snap-count source in this repo. Fitting an ablation on that would measure noise and call it a personnel effect.
_meta.what_is_published_instead: the empty result, with the exact evidence needed to fill it, so the test cannot be redefined later

test_definition.model_a: PR-01 features only (points for / points against, recency weighted)
test_definition.estimand: out-of-sample paired difference in Brier score, with a week-cluster interval
test_definition.reason_no_fixed_penalty: a fixed number of points per missing starter substitutes an assumption for a measurement, and the brief explicitly forbids it

evidence_needed: official inactive lists per game (nfl.com publishes them ~90 min before kickoff)
official snap counts per player per game
an archived injury report series with a capture clock time
